description: This file contains cryptographic utility functions for anonymous tokens, including RSA key conversions, hashing, message encoding, and RSA signature verification, used within the private_membership::anonymous_tokens namespace.

methods.name: PublicMetadataHashWithHKDF
methods.description: Generates a BIGNUM by hashing public metadata with HKDF, using RSA modulus as salt.

methods.name: GetAndStartBigNumCtx
methods.description: Creates and initializes a BIGNUM context for intermediate computations.

methods.name: NewBigNum
methods.description: Creates a new BIGNUM object.

methods.name: BignumToString
methods.description: Serializes a BIGNUM into a fixed-length string with padding.

methods.name: StringToBignum
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a BIGNUM.

methods.name: GetSslErrors
methods.description: Retrieves SSL error messages as a string.

methods.name: GenerateMask
methods.description: Generates a message mask based on RSA public key parameters.

methods.name: MaskMessageConcat
methods.description: Concatenates a mask and message.

methods.name: EncodeMessagePublicMetadata
methods.description: Encodes a message with public metadata for transmission.

methods.name: ProtoHashTypeToEVPDigest
methods.description: Maps protocol hash type enum to OpenSSL EVP_MD digest.

methods.name: ProtoMaskGenFunctionToEVPDigest
methods.description: Maps protocol mask generation function enum to OpenSSL EVP_MD digest.

methods.name: GetRsaSqrtTwo
methods.description: Computes a hard-coded approximation of sqrt(2) as a BIGNUM, adjusted for bit length.

methods.name: ComputePowerOfTwo
methods.description: Computes 2^x as a BIGNUM.

methods.name: ComputeHash
methods.description: Computes hash digest of input data using specified EVP_MD.

methods.name: AnonymousTokensRSAPrivateKeyToRSA
methods.description: Converts protocol buffer RSA private key to OpenSSL RSA object.

methods.name: AnonymousTokensRSAPublicKeyToRSA
methods.description: Converts protocol buffer RSA public key to OpenSSL RSA object.

methods.name: ComputeCarmichaelLcm
methods.description: Computes the Carmichael LCM of phi(p) and phi(q).

methods.name: PublicMetadataExponent
methods.description: Generates an RSA exponent based on public metadata and HKDF.

methods.name: ComputeFinalExponentUnderPublicMetadata
methods.description: Computes an RSA exponent adjusted with public metadata.

methods.name: RsaBlindSignatureVerify
methods.description: Verifies an RSA blind signature with optional public metadata.
